name: DiseaseSpecificResearch
summary: The card component of Disease Specific Research (DUO_0000007). The requester's project intends to use the data for a disease the owner allows, and the requester accepted the terms. Outputs a DataUseConditionCredential about the requester.

allowedDiseases.description: MONDO disease codes the owner allows. An IntendedDataUseCredential qualifies if any entry of claims.useOnlyFor.diseases is in this list.
